Subject: Roadmap gating & release readouts — launch timeline risks

Team,

As we prep the QBR next week, I need a concise readout on the November/Dec launches that are likely to show up as delivery risks. Please treat this as the canonical list I'll share with execs. Quick asks: 

- For each release (Feature A, Feature B, Private Deploy GA) list current status (green/amber/red), primary blocker, ETA for unblock, and suggested mitigation (scope reduction, canary, extra QE/Burn).
- Attach any updated risk matrix or test plans you want reflected in the deck.
- If we need to shift launch windows, flag the minimum timeline slip and product impact.

I'm attaching my working risk matrix (launch_risk_matrix_v3.xlsx) — add a one-line rationale to each row. I'll consolidate into the QBR slides by Friday.

Thanks,
Grace

Subject: Re: Roadmap gating & release readouts — launch timeline risks

Grace —

Quick status for the things I own:

1) Feature A (Realtime batching improvements) — AMBER
   - Primary blocker: upstream gRPC dependency bumped to 1.15.2 causing intermittent invalidation of the KV cache on warm starts. Reproducer in staging.
   - ETA to unblock: 10 business days for backport + CI run (we have a tentative patch).
   - Suggested mitigation: narrow the GA surface — ship without continuous prefix caching for long sequences (fall back to synchronous path) so we can enable the rest. Add a canary at 5% to monitor lat/err.

2) Feature B (Streaming structured outputs) — GREEN (on track)
   - QE currently running extended stability tests; no known regressions.

3) Private Deploy GA (base images + docs) — AMBER
   - Docs backlog + cert signing delay from infra partner (Acme Analytics). If certs arrive late, GA slips by ~2 weeks.
   - Suggestion: soft GA for Trusted Partners only; public GA after cert window closes.

I pushed an initial reproducer and the patch branch: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3247.

Attachment: small repro and notes in the ticket; I'll drop the hotfix patch in a follow-up.

- Aditya

--
Aditya Rao | Eng Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 11:47 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> Grace —
>
> Quick status for the things I own:

Adding technical detail on the KV cache invalidation:

- Root cause: a change in gRPC keepalive surface triggers an edge case where a delayed stream reset causes the runtime to rehydrate a partially-populated KV page. In our case, that results in a mismatch key/seq and an immediate tokenization rollback.
- Short-term fix: enforce strict stream id validation on rehydrate path and add a defensive check before applying page patches. I have a draft fix (kv-cache-hotfix.patch). Testing window required: 48–72 hours in perf/staging to validate under heavy prefix-hot workloads.
- Risk: the fix is low-risk but requires a coordinated kernel CI run (long — ~36 hrs) and additional verification with quantized model configurations.

If we accept the narrowed GA (Aditya's mitigation), we can still ship the majority of the feature set on time and avoid the long CI run for everyone; only the long-seq path remains gated.

(attachment: kv-cache-hotfix.patch)

Dev

Team —

Thanks for the quick digs. For the QBR, we should present both the risk and a simple tradeoff: scope vs. timeline. My recommendation for the deck:

- Present Feature A as a "partial GA" (canary + reduced long-seq surface). This preserves customer-facing improvements and reduces public risk.
- For Private Deploy GA, propose a staggered rollout: Trusted Partners (Acme Analytics) on Dec 8, wider GA Dec 22 pending certs. That buys us time to finish docs and get signatures without moving the public date much.
- Ask: Grace — can we sign off on the partial GA approach? If yes, I'll update the QBR talking points and the product impact slide.

I added notes in Confluence on the rollout plan: https://redwood.atlassian.com/display/INF/Launch+QBR+Notes

-Lauren

Redwood Inference

- Feature A: mark as AMBER -> partial GA. Ship the realtime batching improvements except the long-seq continuous prefix caching path. Canary at 5% on Tuesday (Dec 1). Action: Aditya to land partial feature gate + coordination doc; Dev to run the 48–72h validation on perf/staging (owner + ETA in INF-3247).
- Private Deploy GA: staggered rollout. Trusted Partners (Acme Analytics) Dec 8, public GA Dec 22 pending cert signing. Action: Lauren to own partner comms and doc completion; legal to chase certs with Acme.
- Risk matrix updated: I merged your rows and tightened the impact language — attaching v4 for the QBR slides.

Action items (owners / due):
- Aditya: patch PR + partial gate (PR link in INF-3247) — due Mon, Nov 30
- Dev: perf CI validation — complete by Tue, Dec 1
- Lauren: partner comms + slide update — due Wed, Dec 2

I'll include these in the executive deck and call out the mitigations. If anything changes, flag immediately — we'll escalate in channel.

Thanks — I'll run this in the QBR on Friday.

Grace
